notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
[b]Greetings everyone! Since we had lots of feedback for the demo, and since the demo was not fully updated to match the mechanics and changes the early access version has, we updated it today so anyone who wants to check the demo before getting the game can enjoy all the fixes!

Once again, thanks for the feedback everyone provided so far, more news to come soon enough, and if you want to share anything feel free to do so! 

Stay tuned, stay Savage.

Regards,
Savage Studio [/b]

notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fix[/b]: [i]Fixed some issues with sounds not playing in the correct Location.[/i]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]: [i]Fixed resolution changes breaking Main Menu usability.[/i]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]: [i]Fixed resolution selected in menu not corrisponding to resolution applied in game (affected only high resolutions).[/i]

[b]Bug Fix[/b]: [i]Application no longer goes back to wndowed mode after changing maps / reloading.[/i]

[b]Additionally:[/b] [i]When the Groper boss dies, all the doors open for further exploration and secret finding.[/i]
